title: Credentials entry discoverability: surface credential input path in main wizard flow, not only in Advanced Configuration
goal: The main wizard flow (Choose → Target & Depth → Preview → Authorise) has no credential entry in the primary path. Username, password, API key, bearer token, and session material are only reachable via 'Advanced Configuration → Access'. Operators running authenticated scans will not discover this without guidance. Fix: (1) On the Preview step, when the 'What access or prerequisites do you already have?' section is shown, add a visible link or inline CTA: 'Add credentials in Advanced Configuration →' that opens the Advanced drawer directly to the Access tab. (2) In the Access tab, add a short one-line instruction at the top: 'Enter credentials for authenticated scanning. Fields left empty are skipped.' (3) The username input (first text field in account row) currently has no placeholder — add placeholder 'username or email'. (4) Rename 'All-key Reference or Value' to 'Password or secret ref' so operators recognise the field.
scope: Live wizard audit 2026-05-01: 27 tests passed, all tiles reach preview. The mission preview step shows 'What access or prerequisites do you already have?' with type-selection checkboxes only. Actual credential entry (username, password, API key, bearer token) is hidden in Advanced Configuration → Access. A new operator running an authenticated web scan has no path to enter credentials without knowing the drawer exists. The Access tab username field has no placeholder and 'All-key Reference or Value' label is unclear.
